pages.title: Hyperbolic Stone
pages.text: Stone from a surface that curves away from itself at every point, like a saddle: there is always more room than there should be. Found in Curved Space (the Platonic Realm, Y 560 to 720). The Topology Kiln folds it into Möbius Strips and fires more from cobblestone and Geodesic Thread.
